name: perfect-vibecoding-rules-flutter
description: Battle-tested rules for building Flutter apps with Claude Code: code rules and their checks, session hand-offs under a context budget, working with the owner, parallel builder agents, queued analyzer, test and build tools, and a quality gate. Ships skills, three hooks and project templates.

save_chats.title: Save chats in the project
save_chats.description: Copy each session's transcript into the project folder below. The folder ignores itself in git. Transcripts can hold secrets: never commit or share it.

chats_dir.title: Chats folder
chats_dir.description: Folder, relative to the project root, that receives the transcript copies.

context_budget_k.title: Context budget (thousands of tokens)
context_budget_k.description: Once the context passes this many thousand tokens, Claude writes the handoff and asks for a new session at the next clean point. 0 turns the notice off.
